# knowledge-stats-groups-by-entity-type

knowledge_stats returns counts grouped by EntityRow.entity_type (via SQL GROUP BY) and reports the last successful CompileRun (if any).

Provide aggregated counts per entity type and quick visibility into the last successful compile.
